title: Pendle资管Amy：美债收益率回落，是空头回补还是真需求？
speaker: Amy Xie Patrick

segments.en: I can't speculate on whether the biobases is short covering or genuinely buying. I do think that there is definitely a cohort of investor types globally, just because of the level of where
segments.zh: 我无法推测生物基地是空头回补还是真实买入。我确实认为，全球肯定有一类市场参与者，由于收益率水平，从资产配置角度更被固定收益资产类别所吸引。

segments.en: yields are, are much more attracted to the fixed income asset class from an asset allocation perspective. But the move that we've seen overnight, I don't think it can be sustainable.
segments.zh: 但隔夜我们看到的走势，我认为不可持续。

segments.en: For example, I do not think that we're at the beginning of a 100 basis point rally in US treasuries. I don't see how that can come about when you've got the inflation backdrop the way that
segments.zh: 例如，我不认为我们正处于美国国债100个基点上涨行情的开端。在通胀背景如此的情况下，我看不出这如何能发生。

segments.en: it is, an ever-increasingly hawkish fed determined to fight inflation. And I think, you know, throughout whether it was going to be a democratic sweep or not, Wash has continued to speak with
segments.zh: 美联储日益鹰派，决心对抗通胀。我认为，无论是否出现民主党大胜，沃什一直以足够的可信度谈论他控制美国通胀问题的决心。

segments.en: enough credibility about his determination to get this inflation problem in the US under control.
segments.zh: 所以，新出现的买盘，我更倾向于认为这是空头回补，以及市场已经为债券可能不那么良性的结果和通胀走向、增长更强的局面做好了准备。

segments.en: So, you know, the fresh buying that's coming out, I'm more inclined to think that it's about short covering and it's about, you know, enough of the market having positioned for probably a less
segments.zh: 但再次强调，我是否愿意在**组合中结构性倾向于此，我不会这么说。

segments.en: benign outcome for bonds and position for the way that inflation is heading and growth is stronger.
segments.zh: 对债券而言是良性结果，并为通胀走向和增长更强做好准备。

segments.en: But again, am I willing to lean into this structurally in my portfolios, I wouldn't say so.
segments.zh: 但话说回来，我是否愿意在组合中从结构上偏向这一点，我不会这么说。
